name: agentic-ledger
author: 睿欣工场
description: Agentic 消费管理：把自然语言意图与原始流水转成可逐条核对的分类支出报告。

tools.name: ingest_expenses
tools.description: Parse raw transaction lines (`YYYY-MM-DD <description> <amount>`) into data/transactions.json. Lines that are blank or start with # are ignored. Fails when no line yields a record.

text.description: Raw ledger text, one transaction per line.

tools.name: analyze_spending
tools.description: Aggregate data/transactions.json into reports/spending-<label>.md: per-category totals with share, top-5 expenses, and the date range. Runs as a supervised background task.

label.description: Free-text report label; also derives the filename.

discovery.summary: Agentic 消费管理 app：意图驱动的流水入库与支出分类报告生成，产物可逐条核对。
